name: NEO verified PAPER execution and isolated learning
policy: User-authorized combined four-rule $1,000 PAPER account with independent simulated quote, risk, and safety gates; no live execution.
integrity_note: Mandatory validated flow coverage, exact pool/mint checks, complete safety checks, one effective threshold object, bounded recorded quote latency and uncapped actual modeled losses.
runtime_note: Primary PAPER account runs the four selected Lab entry rules against one shared balance; independent validated training remains separate and can never send live orders.
stop_execution_note: Planned net stop -5%; all observed gap losses and unavailable liquidation risk retained. Never clamps a loss or realizes native SOL as USDC.
hash_change_reasons: Integrate both separately developed branches without losing recorded-data, quote, learner or PnL fixes. Complete the previously orphaned Momentum Rush Brain as an isolated PAPER TEST strategy. Keep strict promoted rules, loss cooldowns and truthful fee/slippage/impact accounting. Record per-book performance uncertainty and observed throughput separately from any target.

support_file_changes.backend/live_tape.py: Bound signature discovery, fetch transaction bodies as individual JSON-RPC objects with v1 support, isolate one request failure from concurrent successes, and retain strict current-window coverage checks.
support_file_changes.backend/strategy_lab.py: Combine bounded Jupiter price checks and net accounting with strict promoted entry/loss guards; register separate TEST-only Momentum Rush Brain using causal exact-pool observations, its own net trade memory and fresh safety checks. Preserve new main Rush-specific 7 percent net take-profit, 20 minute maximum hold and liquidity/verified-flow/trailing exits; keep other books unchanged. Preserve unregistered custom ledgers and their unknown position policies as explicitly inactive across upgrade/restart; never discard their histories or invent fills.
support_file_changes.backend/lab_position_marks.py: Deduplicated background exact-pool DEX Screener spot refresh, bounded to one request per second with identity validation
support_file_changes.backend/lab_dashboard_projection.py: Expose compact per-strategy entry diagnostics and clearly separated realized, unrealized, and marked PAPER PnL for the dashboard. Expose registry compatibility and inactive-book metadata without replacing full ledgers.
support_file_changes.backend/market_monitor.py: Preserve learner evidence probes and primary net exits; select the newest actually observed exact-mint/pool snapshot to prevent reentry using an old pinned mark, while rejecting future evidence and retaining stale-market protection.
support_file_changes.backend/engine_entry_policy.py: Shared fresh pair/mint and market snapshot validation, explicit ensemble signal rejection and execution cost limits
support_file_changes.backend/lab_activity.py: Register broader Momentum Rush PAPER policy without adding it to the promoted winner ensemble.
support_file_changes.backend/winner_ensemble.py: Four-rule signal combination with once-per-mint attribution into one PAPER account
support_file_changes.backend/paper_training.py: Require fresh complete exact-pool flow before allocating quote capacity to learner route evidence
support_file_changes.backend/training_bridge.py: Coalesce identical snapshots and keep training off the exit path; prevent worker restart after bridge shutdown so PAPER services stop without leaving orphan learners.
support_file_changes.backend/training_quote_probe.py: Bounded read-only two-way exact-pool Jupiter quote evidence for isolated PAPER learning
support_file_changes.backend/paper_state_reset.py: Archive and reset recorder/quote-probe diagnostics together with PAPER history so each authorized clean session starts with truthful zeroed counters.
support_file_changes.backend/momentum_rush_brain.py: Causal bounded observation scoring and own-ledger memory; 80 percent remains an unvalidated research target.
support_file_changes.backend/paper_lab_metrics.py: Read-only per-book measurements, malformed/truncated history detection and descriptive sample uncertainty; no automatic promotion.
